_meta.indication: RELYVRIO is indicated for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in adults.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study, randomizing patients 2:1 to AMX0035 or placebo for 24 weeks, with an optional open-label extension (AMX3500OLE).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Prespecified primary endpoint was the rate of decline (slope) of the total ALSFRS-R score over the 24-week study period.
pivotal_trials.result: Statistically significant benefit on primary endpoint: LS mean ALSFRS-R total score 2.32 points higher at Week 24 vs placebo (95% CI 0.18, 4.47; p=0.0340). In a post hoc exploratory analysis of time to death alone at Week 132, the Applicant reports a nominally significant overall survival benefit (HR=0.64; median 23.5 vs 18.7 months; nominal p=0.0475).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (at least 15% and at least 5% greater than placebo) were diarrhea (25% vs 19%), abdominal pain (21% vs 13%), nausea (18% vs 13%), and upper respiratory tract infection (18% vs 10%).
target_moa: The mechanism by which RELYVRIO exerts its therapeutic effects in patients with ALS is unknown. It is a fixed-dose combination of sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol (a bile acid).
modality: Small molecule fixed-dose combination (sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol/bile acid).

advisory_committee.vote: PCNS Advisory Committee convened March 30, 2022, voted 6-4 that data were not sufficient to establish effectiveness; reconvened September 7, 2022, and voted 7-2 (YES: 7, NO: 2) in favor of approval.

summary.text: Traditional (non-accelerated) approval under 505(b)(1) with Priority Review and Orphan Drug designation, based on a single adequate and well-controlled Phase 2 study (AMX3500/CENTAUR) plus confirmatory evidence from long-term survival, applying regulatory flexibility for a serious, life-threatening disease with unmet need. Two Fast Track requests had been denied. The PCNS Advisory Committee, initially voting 6-4 against on March 30, 2022, was reconvened September 7, 2022, and voted 7-2 in favor of approval.

citations.quote: The applicant, Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc., is seeking approval for AMX0035 (RELYVRIO) via 505(b)(1) pathway for the treatment of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) in adults.

Therefore, we conclude that the single, positive study, along with confirmatory evidence from the observed benefit on long-term survival, together demonstrate substantial evidence of effectiveness to support approval of AMX0035 for the treatment of ALS.

Priority or Standard	Priority
Submit Date(s)	October 29, 2021
AMX0035 for the treatment of ALS was granted orphan drug designation on July 27, 2017, and is exempt from PREA requirements.

Therefore, the Peripheral and Central Nervous System Advisory Committee (PCNS) was convened on March 30, 2022, to advise the Agency on the adequacy of the data to establish a conclusion of effectiveness for AMX0035.
The Committee voted 6-4 that the available data were not sufficient to establish a conclusion that AMX0035 is effective in the treatment of ALS.
As part of that review, the PCNS Advisory Committee was reconvened on September 7, 2022, to discuss the additional evidence that was submitted by the Applicant to provide confirmatory evidence.
The Committee Vote: YES: 7 NO: 2 Abstain: 0
